description: Oracle Database stores data in tables and includes the PL/SQL programming language. Learn clear queries, dates, row rules and a small block of PL/SQL with sample book information. Use Oracle Database 19c+ with a SQL editor in a new practice schema. Oracle SQL and PL/SQL do not run in this site's SQLite playground. Create only the named sample objects in that practice schema.
versionNote: Uses Oracle 19c+ SQL, DUAL, identity columns and basic PL/SQL.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to cast another short title as VARCHAR2(40)
Learn to write a date literal for the next club meeting
Learn to explain which rule requires a title
